title: CLAUDE.md's ABSENT case covers a PR head; a pushed dev head can leave a path-filtered required context with ZERO rows, and opening the PR is the remedy
description: Found while promoting 48dec13 (a tracker-only head) on 2026-09-20. The profile section "source-gates fires twice or once per PUSH" measures the one-row case ON A PULL REQUEST (4374c69, ".quest/ only, source-gates x1, and that is COMPLETE"), where the unfiltered pull_request trigger has already produced that row. It does not cover the state BEFORE a PR exists: on a pushed dev head that touches no watched path, source-gates produces ZERO rows, so the required-set predicate correctly returns ABSENT and the required set is unreachable on that SHA by waiting. The remedy is to open the promotion PR, whose pull_request trigger has no path filter and fires every filtered context. Measured: 48dec13 carried only "Tracker integrity" and "lore check" before PR #230 opened, and all three after. opum-agent hit the same defect in its own promote.mjs, which classed ABSENT together with in-flight as unsettled and would poll a context that cannot fire (their OPAG-345, fixed and promoted; opum-agent is not itself affected because its ci.yml has no paths filter). Scope note carried over from them: nobody has enumerated which other fleet repos have path-filtered required workflows, so this is one measured instance, not a fleet-wide finding.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The path-filter section of CLAUDE.md distinguishes the zero-row pre-PR case on a pushed head from the one-row case on a PR, rather than leaving the reader to infer that x1 is the floor
The section names opening the PR as the remedy, and says why it works (the pull_request trigger carries no path filter)
The addition does not restate what QCLI-274, QCLI-318 or QCLI-321 already record, and does not weaken the required-set-by-name predicate, under which ABSENT is never green

plan: 1. Add a short amendment to the path-filter section of CLAUDE.md distinguishing the zero-row pre-PR case from the measured one-row PR case, naming the PR-opening remedy and why it works.
2. Verify the addition does not duplicate QCLI-274/QCLI-318/QCLI-321 and does not weaken the required-set predicate.
implementationNotes: Amendment inserted after the per-PUSH table in the path-filter section, before the NEWEST-PER-CONTEXT paragraph, so a reader meets the zero-row case at the point the table would otherwise imply x1 is the floor. Checked against the three prior records rather than assumed: QCLI-274 records x2-vs-x1 by diff content, QCLI-318 corrects the unit from per-PR to per-PUSH, QCLI-321 corrects the wait predicate to the required-set-by-name intersection. None of the three reaches the pre-PR state, where the count is zero and the required set is unreachable on that SHA by waiting. Verified locally: quest agents --check exit 0 (managed block untouched, only the hand-written profile changed), lore check exit 0, 63 files 0 errors.
finalSummary: Added a dated amendment to the path-filter section of the repository profile in CLAUDE.md distinguishing two absences that read identically: a required context that has not reported YET, and one that CANNOT report on that SHA because its workflow trigger is path-filtered and the head touches no watched path. The section previously measured only the one-row case on a pull request (4374c69), which leaves a reader to infer x1 is the floor; the floor before a PR exists is zero. Names opening the promotion PR as the remedy and why it works (the pull_request trigger carries no path filter), and explicitly does not soften ABSENT, which remains never-green under the required-set-by-name predicate. Verified: measured on 48dec13 during the QCLI-358 promotion (two of three required contexts present before PR #230 opened, all three after, promotion landed fast-forward with no merge commit); quest agents --check exit 0 confirming only hand-written profile prose changed; lore check exit 0 across 63 files. Carries opum-agent OPAG-345 as a second instance of the same defect in their promote.mjs, with their own scope limit preserved rather than widened: neither of us has enumerated which other fleet repos have path-filtered required workflows.
